intended_object: A helper abbreviation from the library's proof of the converse-lift step in its skein argument (Regts–Sevenster). It gives the flag that the right-hand half-edge at cut position m is paired with in the closed fragment `closeBase F G`. This comes from the docstring and from how the library uses it.
explanation: This is a technical device and does not correspond to any standard mathematical object. It is the composite `pairing ∘ boundaryFlag ∘ intR`, applied in one internal gluing construction of the library's flag/fragment encoding of graphs. It exists to shorten statements in later lemmas such as `internal_cutFlagR` and the lemmas in `ConversePair.lean`. Nothing in the literature or in Mathlib plays this role, so it cannot be compared with one.
